# Khabir Diagnostic Auto Pro (خبير داياغنوستيك أوتو برو)

> Specialist electronic diagnostics workshop for German cars in Beni Mellal, Morocco. Diagnoses faults with measurements, codes and programs control units (ECU), and repairs only once a test proves the cause. Written quote before any work.

## Facts
- Location: Near Pharmacie Hay Redouane, Hay Redouane district, Beni Mellal 23000, Morocco. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/hEALPzvM1aEfoSbr5
- WhatsApp and phone: +212 6 32 89 92 18 (Saidi), +212 6 71 76 58 96 (Youssef, the expert)
- Opening hours: Monday to Thursday and Saturday 08:30-19:00, Friday 09:00-19:00, closed Sunday
- Roadside service: travels anywhere in Beni Mellal province to diagnose a car, including at night, every day
- Languages: French, Arabic (Moroccan Darija), English
- Brands: Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen, Porsche, MINI, Skoda, SEAT

## Services
- Engine and ECU diagnostics (warning lights, misfires, limp mode)
- AdBlue, SCR, NOx sensors, DPF and EGR faults
- Automatic gearboxes: DSG, 7G-Tronic, ZF
- ABS, ESP and airbag warning lights
- Electrics and CAN network faults, battery drain
- Coding and programming of replaced control units
